status: PLANNING PARAMETERS of the direct-stack proposal; not evidence and not a tolerance allocation

k_plane.basis: Plan page planning value: K F.Cu = adapter rear face - adapter mated height. Change it here; every plane, gap and clearance is re-derived

obstacle_model.basis: scripts/partition/README.md: 0.35 mm drawn-courtyard free-placement separation and 0.30 mm edge allocation; the same 0.30 mm is applied to through-hole pads on the opposite face and to holes. Tracks, zones and copper are not modelled

probe_tab_top_basis: The first control-tab sketch on the plan page ended at y = 178; measure.py reports how far the SUB pair falls short with that tab

pin_templates.basis: Planning pin orders from the plan page. S = signal slot (source signals in source pin order; an unfilled slot is NC), G = AGND, R = rail. ST-10 fixes the real pin maps
pin_templates.signal_beside_return_note: Required where the plan page states the pin order or the rule. A 1x5 with four signals and one AGND, and the EL-to-P 1x6 with three signals and one AGND, cannot place every signal beside a return; check.py reports those signals

el_rail_rotation_basis: Planning assumption: a 1x6 EL-to-P pair has two rail positions, so each site carries two of the three rails in rotation and each rail reaches EL at four of the six sites

sub_toggle.basis: Owner decision Q2 (SUB toggle); the plan reuses the three-position toggle already fitted on P. Its footprint geometry is copied from an existing P instance at rotation 0
